summary: Full backend pytest suite (20/20 passed) and UI smoke covering: admin login + user/assignment creation, operator & validator scope via localizador-anforas (only 1 of 2 anforas visible), full acta lifecycle (draft → send → observe → correct → resend → lock), authorization/BOLA pentest (operator cannot block own acta, cannot read/write other anforas, non-admins blocked from admin endpoints), and public endpoints (locked acta is published and visible on TREP desktop and Resultados public mobile).

issues: Recharts emits repeated console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — the ResponsiveContainer parent has an initial 0 height during the first render. Non-blocking but noisy; add minHeight to the chart container.

action_items: Optional: wrap Recharts ResponsiveContainer with explicit minHeight to silence width/height(-1) warnings on resultados-publicos.

Optional: consider returning 403 (instead of 404) when a non-admin targets an anfora outside their scope on write/block endpoints, so BOLA errors are explicit; the current 404-leak-minimization behaviour is actually correct security practice (hides existence) and tests accept both.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2442 lines — split into routers (auth, admin, operacion, publico, estructura, resultados) for maintainability.

_autorizar_anfora_operativa correctly enforces: (a) scope by nodos/recintos/anforas, (b) function-specific filtering (carga vs validacion), (c) author-cannot-validate rule across id_creador/id_operador/id_enviado_por. Logic is sound.
Public endpoint /publico/procesos/{id}/actas/{id_anfora} only returns 'esta_bloqueada=True' acts — correct policy.
guardar-acta transitions 'observado'→'borrador' only when editor is not a validator — correct and well-tested.

crear_usuario_operativo hashes with bcrypt via hashear_contrasena (gensalt + checkpw), tokens are JWT HS256 with 12h expiry — standard; consider rotating JWT_SECRET out of default-dev-secret-change-me in prod.
No brute-force lockout on /auth/login — not strictly required by the request but should be considered.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (smoke: operator login + scope UI + public desktop + public mobile)

The test picks the first election with ≥2 anforas via /api/procesos + /api/procesos/{id}/anforas. All data-testid required by Centro Computo (seleccionar-anfora-{id}, enviar-validacion-button, acta-consolidate-block-button, observar-acta-button, etc.) are present. Login route is /acceso, not /.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. All 20 pytest assertions passed including authorization pentests (BOLA/IDOR, self-validate/self-block prevention, admin-only guards). Public pages render on both desktop and mobile with the locked acta exposed as expected.
